task.question: What is the name of the star reported in August 2026 as the closest and fastest star yet observed orbiting Sagittarius A*?
task.evidence: 19 August – Astronomers report the discovery of S301, the closest and fastest star yet observed orbiting Sagittarius A*, the supermassive black hole at the centre of the Milky Way. The star completes an orbit every 8.7 years and reaches about 25,000 km/s, or 8.5% of the speed of light, at its closest approach. Its unusually tight orbit may enable a direct measurement of Sagittarius A*'s spin within about a decade.
